title: lepidaploa uniflora
intro: Lepidaploa uniflora, commonly known as "Lobster's Claw" due to its distinctive shape, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. Lepidaploa uniflora has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-edematous, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating pain, swelling, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Lepidaploa uniflora include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
